checks.evidence: Re-binding is mandatory after threshold breach, step 1-2: failed attempts reach threshold, authenticator disabled, then use is rejected without re-binding. (Also Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use, step 1.) Does not cover waiting past throttling delay or second factor, but the core behavior is the same.

invented: The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled and requires re-binding (explicit error message)
Authenticator status changes to active/bound after re-binding and authentication succeeds with access granted
